descByPlatform.flux: Medium Shot Minimalist Product Launch Poster titled BREW THE NEW ERA for HEARTH HK-9 ceramic kettle. Subject: a matte-sage ceramic kettle #B4C5A8 centred at 50% x, 38-68% y, with soft-curved spout and low arched handle, hand-thrown micro-texture, a tonal cream lid #F2ECE2, and a subtle cast drop-shadow directly below the kettle. Background: a vertical studio gradient running #F2ECE2 top to #8B8F94 bottom as a seamless paper sweep. Composition: Centered Symmetry hero portrait, Eye-Level 0°, kettle occupying 40% of the frame, Rule of Thirds alignment through the spout-tip. Capture: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP medium-format with Schneider 80mm LS at f/11, 1/160s, ISO 50, tripod-mounted, focus-stacked across 5 frames. Lighting: Softbox Studio Side Lighting — 4×6ft softbox camera-left at 45° elevation, 1.5m from subject (key); 4×4ft white v-flat bounce camera-right at 1.2m (fill); 4×4ft black flag overhead to deepen the gradient. Typography: 'BREW THE NEW ERA' 108pt Didot in off-white #F2ECE2 centred at 50% x, 20% y; badge 'LAUNCHING APR 24' 18pt Inter Extrabold cream on a rounded sage chip #5A6E4E at 78% x, 78% y; subhead 'HEARTH HK-9 · PREORDER HEARTH.CO' 13pt Inter tracking-250 at 50% x, 88% y. Color grade: Capture One Neutral-06 LUT, grain 6, +0.1 EV. Palette: sage 42%, cream gradient 32%, cool-grey 16%, sage-chip 6%, shadow 4%. References: Kinfolk editorial, Aesop campaign, Apple 'Think Different'. Exclude: cluttered props, harsh reflections, plastic sheen, colour cast, visible seams.
